patterns.scope: home editorial sections and source-independent editorial translations
patterns.observedFact: In the rendered home-page capture, News, Products and Events are visibly separate editorial sections: News uses repeated media/list groupings, Products pairs compact release rows with a larger product-focused feature, and Events separates a dominant event rail from a narrower schedule panel. Their structures are not one repeated generic card template.
patterns.interpretation: The reusable rule is differentiated editorial rhythm: each content family receives a primary module shape and a denser supporting structure appropriate to its information, while strong display headings and compact metadata maintain continuity across sections.
patterns.recommendation: For a source-independent editorial page, combine one dominant content rail or feature with a structurally distinct compact supporting module; retain terse metadata and avoid wrapping every item in the same generic card. Do not recreate the captured Events section one-for-one.
patterns.meaning: Distinct primary and supporting module shapes create editorial pacing across news, merchandise and event information.
